summary: Sony Group Corporation filed its monthly share buyback report with the SEC as a 6-K, covering repurchases for July 2026. During the month, the company repurchased 18,891,500 shares for ¥66.4 billion at an average price of roughly ¥3,515 per share. This is part of a board-authorized program approved on May 8, 2026, allowing up to 230 million shares or ¥500 billion through May 10, 2027. As of July 31, 2026, the company had repurchased 55,968,100 shares (24.33% of the share cap) for ¥193.9 billion (38.78% of the yen cap), through open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The filing also reports minor treasury dispositions for stock compensation and exercise of stock rights. The steady execution of the buyback enhances per-share metrics and signals management's view of undervaluation. Investors should monitor continued monthly progress and any board updates on the program's pace or expansion.
